reasoningChain.evidence: The immediate goal is to convert the 5%-health Main 7 loss into a clear through more sustained damage.
The spear militia has consistently ranked fourth and supplied only 6-10% of team damage in recent fights.
The rescued ranger is visibly a complete physical hero that keeps attacking one target and accumulates a mark, matching Main 7's sustained-target requirement.
The ranger can legally replace the spear militia while preserving the three proven complete damage heroes.
Replacing the rank-four spear preserves the stronger mage, berserker, and warrior; replacing any of them would discard more verified damage.
If the ranger is a meaningful single-target upgrade, it should exceed 10% of team damage on the Main 7 retry.

hypothesis.problem: The first Main 7 attempt left the high-health enemy at 5% after the team died.
hypothesis.cause: The rank-four spear militia contributes too little sustained single-target damage compared with the rescued ranger's visible specialty.
